title: Embryology and histology
audience: a medical student in the preclinical years
purpose: Explain gametogenesis, fertilization, early development, organogenesis and congenital anomalies, and recognize the histology of epithelium, connective tissue, bone, muscle, nerve, blood and major organs.

weeks.11: Histology of the skin, digestive tract and liver
weeks.12: Histology of the lung, kidney and glands

blocks.deliverable: Explain ectopic pregnancy and the germ layers.
Match five teratogens to their effects.
Classify epithelia by shape and layers and give a location for each.
Week 7 midterm; compare the three muscle types.
Identify white blood cells from descriptions of their features.
Describe the histology of the kidney's nephron segments.
Submit the project; take an unseen 150 minute final in week 14.

project: Development-to-defect atlas: for six organs, link one developmental step to a congenital anomaly and its histological appearance.
completion: finish the project, take the week 7 midterm and week 14 cumulative final, then complete a new cumulative assessment after 1 to 2 weeks. Explain one major idea aloud without notes.
